content.title: Main European Society of Cardiology quality indicators for the evaluation of care and outcomes for patients with heart failure (Table 37)
content.note: A full list is published in a separate article.

domains.name: Structural QIs
domains.main: Centre should have a dedicated multidisciplinary team to manage patients with HF
domains.numerator: Availability of a dedicated multidisciplinary team to manage patients with HF.

mains.description: Proportion of patients with HF who have a documentation of their HF clinical type (HFrEF, HFmrEF, HFpEF)
mains.numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their HF clinical type (HFrEF, HFmrEF, HFpEF).

mains.description: Proportion of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings
mains.numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings.

mains.description: Proportion of patients with HF who have their NPs measured
mains.numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their NPs levels.

mains.description: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol in the absence of any contraindications
mains.numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol.
mains.denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, and nebivolol.
